selection_contract.rule: SCL-02 is selected only. A future owner Continue must perform governed start before exact profile kinds, membership/composition, capability/readiness derivation or application mutation is authorized.

mine_note_routing.RDC-03: SCL-01/SCL-02/SCL-08/SCL-09/SCL-11; explicit identity-preserving aggregation/projection and no duplicate authoritative state/effects

boundaries: unit/formation profiles must remain identity-preserving projections over canonical constituents/assets
